definitions.explanation: The middle point or part of something.
Relating to the main governing body or headquarters, as opposed to local or regional entities.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{中央|ちゅうおう}に{立|た}った。
examples.english: I stood in the center of the room.

examples.japanese: テーブルの{中央|ちゅうおう}に{花|はな}を{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I placed flowers in the center of the table.

examples.japanese: {広場|ひろば}の{中央|ちゅうおう}に{噴水|ふんすい}がある。
examples.english: There is a fountain in the center of the plaza.

examples.japanese: {中央|ちゅうおう}{銀行|ぎんこう}が{金利|きんり}を{決|き}める。
examples.english: The central bank sets interest rates.

examples.japanese: {中央|ちゅうおう}{政府|せいふ}と{地方|ちほう}{自治体|じちたい}の{関係|かんけい}が{議論|ぎろん}されている。
examples.english: The relationship between the central government and local governments is being discussed.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{中央|ちゅうおう}と{地方|ちほう}の{両方|りょうほう}で{考|かんが}える{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This issue needs to be considered by both central and local authorities.

notes:
{中央|ちゅうおう} means the center or middle, often in formal, institutional, or geographic contexts. Combines {中|ちゅう} (middle) + {央|おう} (center).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {中央|ちゅうおう}{政府|せいふ} (central government)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}{銀行|ぎんこう} (central bank)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}{線|せん} (Chuo Line — major Tokyo train line)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}{分離帯|ぶんりたい} (road median)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}{集権|しゅうけん} (centralization of power)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {中央|ちゅうおう}に{置|お}く (to place in the center)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}に{位置|いち}する (to be located in the center)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}: center, middle (casual, everyday)
- {中心|ちゅうしん}: core, heart, center (figurative importance: {都市|とし}の{中心|ちゅうしん})
- {中央|ちゅうおう}: center (formal, institutional, physical position)
